facts: Enron Energy Services is the retail arm of Enron, serving commercial and industrial business users of energy.
Enron Energy Services recorded its first profitable quarter at the end of 1999.
The aggregate recurring income before interest and taxes (IBIT) for Enron Energy Services was $103 million for 2000.
The value of Enron Energy Services contracts in 2000 totaled more than $16 billion.
The cumulative contract value for Enron Energy Services exceeded $30 billion since late 1997.
Enron Energy Services marked increased activity in Europe in 2000.
